The '''Ku'rys''' were a clan of lazy [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] that controlled the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Joreikna]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the clan was led by the indecisive [[Ged Ku'rys]] and was rivals with the [[Rooshan]] clan of [[Lohema]].<ref name="GatORW" />
